name: @pipeworx/mcp-kraken

tools.name: server_time
tools.description: Return the Kraken exchange server time as Unix timestamp and RFC 1123 string. Use to synchronize request timestamps.

tools.name: system_status
tools.description: Return the current Kraken exchange operational status (online, cancel_only, post_only, limit_only, maintenance) and timestamp.

tools.name: assets
tools.description: Kraken crypto exchange asset info: precision, status, alt-name, conversion factor for crypto assets (BTC, ETH, USDT, etc.) and fiat.

tools.name: asset_pairs
tools.description: Kraken crypto exchange tradable pair info: base/quote, lot decimals, fee schedule, leverage limits, ordermin. Use as a directory before depth/ticker/ohlc calls.

tools.name: ticker
tools.description: Kraken crypto exchange live ticker for a pair (e.g. "XBTUSD"). PREFER for 'current price of <coin>', 'bid and ask for <coin>', 'BTC spread'. Returns named bid, ask, spread, last_price, open_price, volume_24h and vwap_24h alongside Kraken's raw single-letter fields (a/b/c/v/p/o).

tools.name: ohlc
tools.description: Kraken crypto exchange OHLC candles for a pair. Intervals 1, 5, 15, 30, 60, 240, 1440, 10080, 21600 minutes. Use for charting Kraken pairs.

tools.name: depth
tools.description: Kraken crypto exchange order book — bids + asks for a crypto pair. Returns price/volume/timestamp per level. Use for live depth-of-book on Kraken-listed pairs.

tools.name: trades
tools.description: Kraken crypto exchange recent trade tape for a pair. Returns price, volume, timestamp, buy/sell, market/limit. Use for tick-level execution analysis.

tools.name: spread
tools.description: Kraken crypto exchange recent bid/ask spread history for a pair. Returns timestamped best-bid + best-ask. Use for liquidity studies.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-kraken forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the kraken pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
